# InfiniMii

> InfiniMii is a searchable Nintendo Mii character database and toolkit for browsing, converting, downloading, and transferring Miis across Nintendo systems.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://infinimii.com/): Overview of the site, browse sections, and core tools.
- [Trending Miis](https://infinimii.com/trending): Public Mii characters getting the most attention.
- [Top Miis](https://infinimii.com/top): Highest-rated public Mii characters.
- [Recent Miis](https://infinimii.com/recent): Newly uploaded public Mii characters.
- [Official Miis](https://infinimii.com/official): Official Nintendo Miis preserved from games, promotions, and systems.
- [Search](https://infinimii.com/search): Search form for Mii characters, uploaders, text, and tags.
- [Mii Dashboard](https://infinimii.com/miiDashboard): Render Miis, edit MiiJS decoded JSON, convert formats, create Special Mii exports, generate 3DS/Wii U/Tomodachi Life QR codes, view recreation instructions, and run Kidomatic.
- [QR Scanner](https://infinimii.com/qr): Scan Mii QR codes and decode them into exportable data.
- [Amiibo Tools](https://infinimii.com/amiibo): Extract or insert Miis from Amiibo backups.
- [Wii Remote Tools](https://infinimii.com/wiimote): Read and write Wii Remote Mii slots in supported browsers.
- [Transfer Guide](https://infinimii.com/guides/transfer): Guide to moving Miis between Nintendo systems.
- [Mii Format Guide](https://infinimii.com/guides/formats): Overview of common Mii formats and when to use each one.
- [FAQ](https://infinimii.com/faq): General questions about Miis, transfers, QR codes, and site usage.
- [Cite InfiniMii](https://infinimii.com/cite): Citation and attribution guidance.

## Notes For Assistants

- Prefer guide pages and the FAQ for general questions about Miis, transfers, formats, and site workflows.
- Prefer specific `/mii/<id>` pages when answering questions about an individual Mii character.
- Search result pages and random pages are not canonical long-term references.
- Auth, account, private collection, and moderator pages are not intended as public reference content.
